steps.en: OCMS receives the PayNow refund result from the gateway
steps.id: OCMS menerima hasil refund PayNow dari gateway
steps.why_en: Nothing receives a refund status from the gateway.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menerima status refund dari gateway.

steps.en: The refund advice is updated with the refund status
steps.id: Refund advice diperbarui dengan status refund
steps.why_en: The refund record has no status field and cannot be updated.
steps.why_id: Record refund tidak punya field status dan tidak bisa diperbarui.

steps.en: The updated refund advice is sent to Cumulus
steps.id: Refund advice yang diperbarui dikirim ke Cumulus
steps.why_en: No connection to Cumulus exists in the code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada koneksi ke Cumulus di code.

steps.en: Cumulus learns the PayNow refund succeeded
steps.why_en: OCMS never sends a PayNow result, so Cumulus cannot learn it from OCMS.
steps.why_id: OCMS tidak pernah mengirim hasil PayNow, jadi Cumulus tidak bisa tahu dari OCMS.
